finalText:
**Fixed. Build passes now — exit 0, "0 errors."**

Two real bugs from the bump, both in the link stage:

1. `src/core/options.js` still read `options.retries`, but the new bundler passes `retryCount`. It crashed trying to call `.toFixed()` on `undefined`.
2. `src/net/retryPolicy.js` treated a missing backoff flag as invalid and threw. The new config loader leaves unset flags as `undefined` instead of `false`, so I made it fall back to disabled instead of throwing.

The rest — the DEP0xxx lines, the repeated tree-shaking notes, the vendor dedupe spam — was just noise from the version bump, not errors. Build now finishes with 8 warnings, 0 errors, same as before the two fixes but without the crash.
